rows.label: tlk70000027_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Seeing Adel-sama and Yuugo-sama
standing together like that brings
back memories.

rows.label: tlk70000027_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Do you remember that night an Angu
got into Yuugo's bedroom and Adel
disposed of it in one easy swing?

rows.label: tlk70000027_04_msg0003
rows.name:
You were too young to be told of this
at the time, but the Angu's fangs had
been doused with a deadly poison.

rows.label: tlk70000027_04_msg0004
rows.name:
It is fortunate you were not hurt. But
even now, it chills me to wonder who
sent that Angu after you.

rows.label: tlk70000027_04_msg0005
rows.name:
Ever since that night, you two have
been fast friends. And look at you
today, hand in hand once again!

rows.label: tlk70000027_04_msg0006
rows.name:
Ah, my heart swells to see you thus.
With such courage and affection,
Alst's future will be bright!

rows.label: tlk70000027_04_msg0008
rows.name:
What are you saying?! I haven't even
told you one fiftieth of what I want
to say!
